messages:

Subject: QuestBridge security intake & evidence sprint planning

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time to evaluate Redwood Inference. To make the SOC 2 / CAIQ intake efficient, can we lock a 45-minute intake on Wednesday 4/21? Goal: align on scope, owners for evidence, and sample log export windows so we can hand off a clean action register.

Proposed agenda:
- 10m intros & scope (prod vs staging)
- 15m CAIQ gaps & high-priority controls
- 10m log/sample access and retention scope
- 10m next steps, owners, timelines

Pre-call asks (attached):
- Quick CAIQ pre-fill (sheet marked with baseline answers) — questbridge_precall_caiq.xlsx
- Small sample log export (1 hour window) — see log-sample-spec.md for formats we typically accept

If Wednesday doesn't work, I can do Thursday morning PST. Please confirm attendees and preferred time.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Hi Rishi —

Wednesday 4/21 11:00am PT works for us (Jordan, Aisha + our InfoSec lead might join — finalizing). Thanks for the agenda, looks good. A couple quick clarifications before the call:

- For the log sample, can you accept S3 presigned URLs or do you need direct transfer?
- We have a 90-day retention policy for application logs in prod, but infra logs are only 30 days — is that an issue for the CAIQ evidence set?

I'll have Aisha pull the prefill and share a calendar invite. Looking forward to the call.

— Jordan
VP Product | QuestBridge
jordan.lee@questbridge.com | 650-555-0199

Jordan — great, confirmed for 4/21 11:00am PT. Calendar invite received. Quick replies to your questions so the call can focus on owners: 

- S3 presigned URLs are perfect. For the sample logs we only need a 1-hour slice and a README describing the fields; see log-sample-spec.md for the exact keys. If you prefer, we can accept a redacted export via presigned URL.
- 30-day infra logs are fine; we'll map controls to available retention and flag anything that requires extended retention as a gap with a proposed remediation cadence.

Meeting dial-in / link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/rm-questbridge-0421 (added to invite)

On the call we'll ask for the following owners to be assigned after the intake:
- CAIQ owner (technical) — responsible for filling evidence artifacts (expected: Aisha)
- Log owner — provide sample exports and sampling windows (suggested: infra engineer)
- Legal/Procurement — point of contact for any DPA/contract redlines (if needed)

See attached action-register stub; we'll populate during the call.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@questbridge.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: QuestBridge — intake notes, owners, and 2-week sprint plan

Hi all —

Thanks for the productive intake today. Notes and agreed actions below; placing owners and tentative due dates so we can kick off the evidence sprint.

Summary of scope:
- CAIQ coverage: standard SaaS footprint (auth, storage, network, ops). Exclusions: customer-managed sandbox environments.
- Evidence priority: encryption-at-rest/configs, IAM lists, log samples, incident response runbook snippet.

Action register (high level):
1) CAIQ completed prefill (technical answers) — owner: Aisha Khan (QuestBridge) — due: 2027-04-28
2) Provide 1-hour application log sample via presigned S3 URL + README — owner: Infra team (QuestBridge) / contact: Aisha — due: 2027-04-25
3) Upload IAM role list and SSO metadata export — owner: Aisha — due: 2027-04-28
4) Provide SOC 2-friendly retention policy snippet or pointer to policy doc — owner: Legal/Compliance (QuestBridge) — due: 2027-05-03
5) Redwood to deliver CAIQ gap register and recommended remediation plan — owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) — due: 2027-05-05
6) Optional: short follow-up demo of log export tooling if QuestBridge wants assistance — owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) — schedule if requested

Notes from discussion:
- QuestBridge will use presigned S3 links; we confirmed redaction is acceptable for PII fields.
- Retention mismatch (app logs 90d vs infra 30d) will be documented as a control gap with suggested mitigations (tiered retention or archived exports).
- No immediate contract redlines flagged; procurement will surface any in the next week.

Next steps for Redwood: I'll produce a CAIQ gap register and a short runbook describing where to place artifacts in the shared intake folder. Expect the gap register by 2027-05-05.

If anyone wants the raw meeting transcript or recording link ping me and I will share.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: questbridge_action_register.csv (CSV, 2KB)
